The IDE workspace is a zip file, which unzips into a folder called `ar4ds-eu-workspace-main`; on Windows, choose "Extract All" rather than working inside the compressed preview. Open the folder in your IDE, in RStudio through the file `ar4ds-eu-workspace.Rproj` inside it, and run `R/check_setup.R` until it reports no failure, as [the setup page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html#check-that-it-works) describes. The tasks are in the report `index.qmd` of the same folder.
